system.description: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the @Lookup[@name]. The @Lookup[@name] occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the @Lookup[@name] is spotlighted, and the @Lookup[@name] can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the @Lookup[@name] or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a [[/r d6]]. On an even result, they target the @Lookup[@name]. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the @Lookup[@name], the duplicate is dispelled until you spend a Fear to conjure it again.
